title: Hof published-artifact acceptance evidence
description: Immutable, Cosign-signed record that a real acceptance run on protected main exercised one exact published candidate's own signed artifacts across the full required restore matrix and passed. Consumed by promote.yml as its gate: a candidate is never promoted to the stable channel without a schema-valid, succeeded evidence document that (a) is signed by the acceptance workflow's exact OIDC identity, (b) records the acceptance run's own GitHub-verifiable provenance, and (c) binds to the candidate's release-lock digest byte for byte.

candidate.description: The immutable candidate tag the acceptance run downloaded and exercised.

release.description: The plain platform release version the candidate would promote to (candidate tag minus the -rc.N suffix).

commit.description: The exact hof-ops commit the candidate was built from. Promotion requires acceptanceCommit to equal this and the candidate release's own target commit.

releaseLockDigest.description: SHA-256 of the candidate's published release-lock.json, byte for byte. Promotion refuses unless this equals the digest of the release-lock.json actually attached to the candidate release.

executionEnvironmentDigest.description: The pinned Ansible Execution Environment image digest the candidate's release lock names, recorded so promotion can confirm acceptance ran the same EE the lock ships.

acceptanceWorkflowPath.description: Fixed. Promotion cross-checks the acceptance run's own .path against this and Cosign-verifies this evidence against acceptance.yml@refs/heads/main.

acceptanceWorkflowRef.description: Fixed. Acceptance runs only from protected main.

acceptanceRunId.description: The GitHub Actions run id that produced this evidence. Promotion is handed this id explicitly and refuses a mismatch.

acceptanceRunAttempt.description: The run attempt. Promotion cross-checks the live run's own run_attempt.

acceptanceCommit.description: head_sha of the acceptance run. Must equal both the live run's head_sha and `commit`.

acceptanceRunUrl.description: html_url of the acceptance run. Promotion cross-checks the live run's own html_url.

result.description: Overall outcome: succeeded only when every required scenario and every destination inside it succeeded. A failed document is still published and retained for the audit trail; promotion refuses it.

scenarios.description: Exactly the two required whole-platform restore legs. Promotion additionally refuses duplicate scenarioIds and any missing leg.

destinations.description: Both restic destinations are exercised and recorded explicitly in every leg.

result.description: succeeded only when both destinations in this leg succeeded.
